summary.text: Leshrac, the Walker of Night, is a planeswalker and necromancer who manipulated Lim-Dul, joined the Ice Age plots with Tevesh Szat, and finally fought Nicol Bolas.

bio.text: Lim-Dul swore himself body and soul to Leshrac, who later mutated him and cut off his hand in Lim-Dul's last battle against Jodah.

Trapped in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds during the Ice Age, Leshrac summoned an elder dragon against Kristina of the Woods, and at the Summit of the Null Moon he joined Faralyn and Szat in betraying the other planeswalkers.
He escaped to Shandalar and began the War for Shandalar, but without his undead host he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal.
Later, in the Planeswalker War, he rang the Grey Chime and Telemar went up in a mushroom cloud, and Taysir defeated and imprisoned him in Phyrexia.
In the Time Spiral era he took over Jeska's mind to close the rifts at Yavimaya and Zhalfir, accepted a copy of the Mask of Night's Reach, and attacked Nicol Bolas.
Bolas had been playing him: he impaled Leshrac, trapped his essence in the true mask, and used it to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac.

status.text: Leshrac was killed when Bolas closed the Madaran rift with his trapped essence, though decades later his spirit emerged from his mantle when Vaash Vroga lost control of it and then departed.
